name: Loktak Lake
description: Largest freshwater lake in Northeast India in Bishnupur district, famous for floating phumdis (heterogeneous biomass islands) and home to the world's only floating national park. Ramsar wetland of international importance.
facts: Coordinates 24.55°N 93.783°E from Wikipedia
Surface area varies 250-500 km²; average depth 2.7 m
Designated Ramsar site in 1990 (site no. 463)
Supports unique ecosystem for Sangai deer and migratory birds
District: Bishnupur; sources: Wikipedia, official Manipur Tourism, Ramsar, bishnupur.nic.in

name: Keibul Lamjao National Park
description: The world's only floating national park on the largest phumdi of Loktak Lake in Bishnupur district. Last natural habitat of the endangered Sangai (brow-antlered deer), Manipur's state animal.
facts: Established 1977; area about 40 km²
Home to Sangai (Rucervus eldii eldii), hog deer, otters, and migratory birds
Accessed by boat from Sendra or Keibul village
District: Bishnupur; sources: Wikipedia, Manipur Forest Department, bishnupur.nic.in

name: Sendra Island
description: Rocky hillock island in Loktak Lake in Bishnupur offering panoramic views of floating phumdis. Features Sendra Tourist Home; popular for photography, boating, and sunrise/sunset.
facts: Connected by causeway; hilltop provides 360° lake views
Boats to Keibul Lamjao depart from here
About 50 km from Imphal
District: Bishnupur; sources: official tourism, bishnupur.nic.in

name: INA Martyrs' Memorial Complex
description: Historic memorial and museum at Moirang in Bishnupur district commemorating the Indian National Army. Site where the INA flag was first unfurled on Indian soil on 14 April 1944 under Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.
facts: Located about 45 km south of Imphal in Bishnupur district
Includes replica of Singapore INA memorial, museum, library, and statue
Coordinates ~24.5025°N 93.7769°E
District: Bishnupur; sources: Wikipedia, bishnupur.nic.in official tourist places

name: Bishnupur Vishnu Temple
description: 15th-century brick temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu in Bishnupur town, after which the town and district are named. Built by King Kyamba; protected historical monument.
facts: Located in Bishnupur town (HQ of the district)
Built around 1467 by King Kyamba
Conical brick structure of historical importance
District: Bishnupur; sources: Wikipedia, bishnupur.nic.in

name: Loukoipat Ecological Park
description: Scenic eco-park with a small lake surrounded by green hillocks near Bishnupur town. Offers boating and panoramic valley views; popular for picnics and relaxation.
facts: Located on outskirts of Bishnupur district headquarters
Small lake with boating facilities
Surrounded by green hillocks
District: Bishnupur; sources: bishnupur.nic.in official places-of-interest

name: Thanga Island
description: Largest inhabited island in Loktak Lake in Bishnupur, home to Meitei fishing communities living on solid ground and stilted huts. Features traditional athaphum fishing traps and folklore museum.
facts: Accessible by boat; showcases traditional lake lifestyle
Home to Loktak Folklore Museum
Part of the Loktak ecosystem
District: Bishnupur; sources: tourism descriptions, GeoNames

name: Red Hill (Maibam Lotpa Ching)
description: WWII historical hillock in Nambol, Bishnupur district, site of fierce 1944 battle between Allied and Japanese forces. Features India Peace Memorial and Imphal Peace Museum; pilgrimage site for Japanese visitors.
facts: About 17 km south of Imphal on Tiddim Road (NH-150)
Coordinates 24.703°N 93.817°E from Wikipedia
India Peace Memorial constructed by Japanese veterans
District: Bishnupur; sources: Wikipedia, bishnupur.nic.in

name: Phubala
description: Charming resort village on the western fringes of Loktak Lake in Bishnupur district, about 40 km south of Imphal. Popular for boating, lake views, and as a quieter alternative to main tourist spots.
facts: On western fringes of Loktak Lake
About 40 km from Imphal
Developed for water sports and picnics
District: Bishnupur; sources: bishnupur.nic.in official tourist places

name: Moirang
description: Historic town in Bishnupur district about 45 km from Imphal, sacred to Manipuri people and site of the first INA flag unfurling. Gateway to Loktak Lake and INA memorial complex.
facts: About 45 km south of Imphal
Site of INA flag unfurling on 14 April 1944
Home to Ibudhou Thangjing Temple
District: Bishnupur; sources: bishnupur.nic.in, Wikipedia
